landing.hero.title: Don't just find the highest mandi price.
landing.hero.gradientTitle: Find where you take home the most.
landing.hero.subtitle: Two mandis can offer different prices. But the mandi paying the most may not leave the farmer with the most money.
landing.hero.description: Kisan360 compares markets by {strong}net realization{strongEnd} — the headline price minus the costs{em} you{emEnd} bear as a farmer: transport, storage and loading. Then it helps you create a lot, find buyers with transparent trust tiers, send an offer and track the payment — in one place.
landing.hero.demoNote: Sign in as a demo farmer, buyer or FPO. Payments and buyer verification are simulated — clearly labelled in the app.
landing.feature1.title: Compare what you keep
landing.feature1.desc: A higher headline price can mean a lower take-home once transport and storage are counted. We rank by net, not hype.
landing.feature2.title: Every number has a source
landing.feature2.desc: Prices come from AGMARKNET (Govt. of India) with live/cached status and timestamps. The AI only explains results — it never invents figures.
landing.feature3.title: Sell with confidence
landing.feature3.desc: Four-tier buyer trust badges, digital offers, payment-status tracking and FPO bulk pooling — with the simulated parts said out loud.
landing.pillar.title: Built to sit on top of India's existing mandi ecosystem — not replace it.
landing.pillar.desc: Kisan360 is a decision layer over the data sources farmers and FPOs already have: AGMARKNET/eNAM price feeds in, explainable sell decisions out, connected to lots, buyers and offer workflows. It integrates with APMC/eNAM/FPO systems rather than asking anyone to abandon them — and every figure shows its source, timestamp and assumption.
landing.band.text: From the field to the mandi — every price below is an observation with a timestamp, and every cost a documented assumption.
landing.footer: Prototype built for SIH 2026 · Commission/adat is charged to the buyer under the Maharashtra APMC Act s.31 — never deducted from the farmer's net.

landing.problem.label: The number nobody subtracts
landing.problem.title: The mandi with the biggest number on the board is often not the one that pays you the most.
landing.problem.afterCosts: After transport, loading and mandi charges
landing.problem.footnote: Both are real AGMARKNET observations for onion from a Nashik origin. The gap is what the farmer pays to get there — diesel, loading, hamali and mandi charges. Kisan360 does that subtraction for every mandi, for your crop and your lot size.
landing.how.label: How it works
landing.how.title: Three steps from standing crop to money in hand
landing.how.s1: Compare on net, not on the board
landing.how.s1d: Pick your crop, district and lot size. Every reachable mandi is ranked by what actually reaches you after costs.
landing.how.s2: Grade the lot, then match a buyer
landing.how.s2d: Assess quality against AGMARK thresholds, list the lot, and see verified buyers, their demand and their trust tier.
landing.how.s3: Send the offer, track the payment
landing.how.s3d: Digital offers, a payment timeline and logistics coordination — with a grievance route if the buyer does not pay.
landing.how.cardSub: Every price is an observation. Every cost is a documented assumption.
landing.how.cardWhyBody: Hingna shows ₹300 more per quintal on the board, but it is 610 km away. Junnar is 164 km away and still leaves ₹368 more per quintal in the farmer's hand.
landing.quote.label: The problem we were asked to solve
landing.quote.text: “Many farmers… have limited visibility of current and expected prices across nearby markets, processors, institutional buyers and digital trading channels. … Farmers may sell immediately after harvest because of liquidity or storage constraints and may have weak bargaining power.”
landing.quote.attr: Problem Statement SIH26132 · Government of Maharashtra, Maharashtra State Innovation Society
landing.evidence.label: Built to be checked
landing.evidence.title: Nothing on this page asks you to take our word for it.
landing.evidence.l1: fresh-vs-rotten accuracy of the crop grader running in your browser
landing.evidence.l2: backend tests passing, including the net-realization and payment arithmetic
landing.evidence.l3: languages — English, मराठी and हिन्दी — across the whole selling flow
landing.evidence.l4: crops graded against published AGMARK quality thresholds
landing.evidence.note: The payment rails, buyer verification and escrow in this prototype are simulated and labelled as such on every screen. Market prices are real AGMARKNET pulls, with live-versus-cached status shown per request.
landing.cta.title: See what your own lot would earn
landing.cta.sub: One minute, no signup, and no cost left hidden.
landing.footer.line: A market-intelligence and transaction layer for farmers, FPOs and buyers.
landing.hero.tryNow: Run the numbers on your lot
landing.calc.label: Try it right here — no signup
landing.calc.title: What would your lot actually earn?
landing.calc.sub: This calls the same net-realization engine the app uses. Pick a crop, your district and a lot size, and it ranks every reachable mandi by what actually reaches you — after transport, handling and mandi charges.
landing.calc.error: The engine did not answer just now, so this is the last verified result for this selection. In the app, live and cached states are labelled on every screen.
landing.calc.provDetTitle: These figures come from a deterministic cost model. The AI only explains a result — it never generates one.
landing.calc.pool: Pooled with an FPO at 40 quintals or more, the freight rate halves to ₹0.75 per quintal per km. That is what aggregation is worth.
landing.calc.invBody: {board} shows {boardDelta} per quintal more on the board — and still leaves you {netDelta} per quintal worse off.
landing.calc.invNone: Today the board leader is also your best take-home. That is not always true — try another crop, district or lot size.
landing.calc.breakEven: Break-even: {challenger} only overtakes this one if your effective transport rate falls below {rate}/q/km — for instance by sharing a truck. Today's assumption is {now}/q/km, so there is {headroom}% of headroom before that happens.
landing.calc.howFormula: Net = board price − transport − storage − bags, loading and market entry.
landing.calc.howTransport: Transport: ₹1.50 per quintal per km, from a hired light commercial vehicle (about ₹120/km across roughly 80 quintals). At 40 quintals or more, full-truck freight halves to ₹0.75.
landing.calc.howStorage: Storage: ₹1 per quintal per day, two days assumed before sale.
landing.calc.howOther: Other: ₹20 per quintal — bags ₹8, loading ₹5, unloading and market entry ₹7.
landing.calc.howBuyer: The APMC market fee (0.5%) and the commission agent fee (1%) are charged to the buyer under the Maharashtra APMC Act s.31, so we never deduct them from your net.
landing.calc.howDistance: Distances are documented road distances where available, otherwise geodesic estimates. Production replaces this distance table with OSRM routing.
landing.calc.fullNote: Same engine, more detail: storage windows, sale timing and the full cost ledger.
landing.risk.label: When the money does not arrive
landing.risk.title: Most builds stop at 'offer accepted'. The problem statement asks for the hard part.
landing.risk.paidBody: The offer is accepted, escrow holds the money, dispatch is logged and the payment is released to the farmer — with a timestamped step at every stage.
landing.risk.paidS1: Offer accepted and recorded against the lot
landing.risk.paidFoot: Every step carries a timestamp, a lot ID and an actor.
landing.risk.unpaidBody: The farmer raises a grievance from the same screen. It carries the lot, the offer, the payment status and the evidence with it — nothing has to be re-typed or re-proved.
landing.risk.stageNote: A real state machine — OPEN to UNDER_REVIEW to RESOLVED — with the authority's action recorded against the case.
landing.risk.unpaidFoot: Grievance handling is a stated requirement of SIH26132, not an afterthought.
landing.who.label: Built for all three sides
landing.who.title: A farmer cannot fix a fragmented market alone. Neither can a buyer.
landing.who.farmer1: Rank every reachable mandi by take-home, not by board price
landing.who.farmer2: Grade the lot against AGMARK quality thresholds before listing it
landing.who.farmer3: Follow the offer, the dispatch and the payment in one place
landing.who.fpo1: Pool member lots to halve the freight paid per quintal
landing.who.fpo2: Certify pooled quality on each grade certificate
landing.who.fpo3: Split one buyer contract back across the members who filled it
landing.who.buyer1: Aggregate consistent volumes across a district
landing.who.buyer2: See graded lots with a quality certificate instead of a phone description
landing.who.buyer3: Coordinate pickup and see payment status in the same thread
landing.who.tierNote: Buyers carry a trust tier — self-declared, demo-verified, source-verified or fully verified — and the app shows which one before a farmer commits.

netRealization.title: Compare What You'll Earn
netRealization.subtitle: What you actually pocket at each mandi — after your transport, storage and loading costs. Deterministic: no AI invents these numbers.

netRealization.onlyOneMandiDesc: A comparison — and the best-market recommendation — needs at least two costed mandis. The economics above are correct for this market alone; the ranking data may be limited today (live feed anomaly or cache gap).
netRealization.whatCouldChangeDesc: Change the quantity — every scenario is recomputed server-side by the deterministic engine. Nothing is pre-scripted or estimated in the browser.
netRealization.whatIfSell: What if I sell {qty} q instead of {current}?
netRealization.buyerCoverageDesc: Buyer coverage in the current Kisan360 directory — deterministic matching on crop, service area and minimum quantity. Not a demand estimate.

netRealization.estimatedDecisionDiff: estimated decision difference — not an income guarantee
netRealization.noCompatibleBuyer: No compatible buyer found in the current Kisan360 directory for this lot.

netRealization.chasingCosts: Chasing the ₹{gap}/q higher headline at {market} would cost you ₹{netGap}/q ({lotTotal} on this lot) in extra farmer-borne costs. Kisan360 ranks by what you keep — not by the biggest number.
netRealization.explainedBy: AI explanation based on Kisan360 market calculations · explained by: {by} · the AI never generates the numbers.
netRealization.costOfActionable: Estimated cost of taking the immediately actionable path:
netRealization.alsoSee: or review the alternative mandis below
netRealization.ofMandisHaveBuyers: of {total} costed mandis have directory buyers for this lot.
netRealization.atQty: At {qty} q, the best mandi is

netRealization.netUnchanged: Net per quintal is unchanged — quantity alone does not move per-quintal costs below the bulk threshold.

netRealization.whyPooledThreshold: Why: pooled volume crosses the 40 q full-truck threshold — transport drops from ₹1.5 to ₹0.75 per quintal-km, so logistics economics change.
netRealization.whyRankingHeld: Why: the ranking held because per-quintal transport only drops at the 40 q full-truck threshold.

fpo.title: FPO Bulk Selling
fpo.subtitle: Pool produce. Negotiate as one lot. See exactly who gains what.
fpo.demoNote: Demonstration using simulated FPO member data — no real farmer impact is claimed.
fpo.pathB: Path B — pool with the FPO
fpo.logisticsStory: The logistics story — many small trips become one
fpo.extraTransport: average transport each member pays alone
fpo.buyerCoverage: Buyer coverage at pooled size ({quantity} q)
fpo.coverageNote: Coverage = deterministic match on crop, service area and minimum quantity in the current directory. Not a demand estimate.
fpo.pathADesc: the decision you just made on the calculator
fpo.attachRef: Run the calculator to attach a best-mandi reference to this path.
fpo.pathASmall: Small-lot transport tier; buyers with minimums above {q} q are out of reach.
fpo.pathBLine2: Full-truck transport tier from 40 q pooled; processor minimums unlocked.
fpo.pathBLine3: Compute below to see the pooled mandi, uplift and buyer coverage.
fpo.sameEngine: Both paths use the same engine, the same quotes and the same directory. Kisan360 shows consequences — you choose the path.
fpo.pooledHint: The roster below pools about {q} q. Compute to price the real pool.
fpo.errorDesc: The calculator did not respond. Check the connection and try again.
fpo.rosterHint: The members of this FPO and the quantity each one contributes.
fpo.mockedNote: Simulated FPO member households for the SIH demo — not real users. In production, member lots would be pulled from real farmer accounts. Prices and the cost model are real; the buyer directory is a demo list.
fpo.memberEconomicsHint: What each member takes home pooled, against selling alone.
fpo.sumSolo: If every member sold alone at their own best mandi
fpo.oneBulkTrip: one full-truck trip for the whole group
fpo.keptByGroup: {qty} q pooled · {amount} kept by the group
fpo.fartherAtBulkRate: a farther market, but at the full-truck bulk rate to {market}
fpo.worthItBecause: {amount} extra transport, but {pooled}/q pooled against {solo}/q selling alone
fpo.upliftFromMarket: The gain comes from reaching {amount} more in a larger market — not from cheaper transport.
fpo.tradeoffTitle: The trade-off — a longer haul for a better price
fpo.coverageBody: Pooling lifts the quantity above the processor minimums no single member can meet on their own.
fpo.createFailed: The pooled lot could not be created.
fpo.createdNotice: Pooled lot of {qty} q of {crop} created — opening trade.
fpo.reasonBulk: Pooled {q} q qualifies for the full-truck transport rate (₹0.75/q/km vs ₹1.5/q/km for small lots), so the same mandi ({mandi}) nets each member more per quintal.
fpo.reasonNoBulk: Pooled {q} q did not reach the full-truck threshold (40 q) — the uplift comes only from mandi price differences, not from the bulk transport rate.
fpo.logisticsNote: Each member individually hauls to their own best mandi; the pooled lot makes one trip. Transport figures come from the same deterministic engine (₹/q/km × documented road distance).
fpo.engineNote: Members are demo households; prices and costs come from the deterministic calculator on real AGMARKNET data.
